scope: Codex Responses Lite compatibility (additional_tools, configuration_update, custom freeform tools) and an opt-in enterprise ChatHub session routing pin, verified on the deployed target container.

regression.note: Run against the worktree source. A first full run caught the routing attribute being set on client objects without __dict__; it is now set only when the toggle is on.

pre_change_isolated_comparison.method: Two isolated loopback listeners in the container on private copies of the account store: installed code versus patched copy. Production files only read.

installed_code.codex_lite_request: HTTP 400 Unsupported Responses input item type: additional_tools

patched_code.codex_lite_gpt_5_5_chat: streaming exec_command call in namespace functions; continuation response.completed containing the caller nonce
patched_code.gpt_6_sol_and_gpt_6_chat: upstream InternalError / empty reply twice, also for a plain request without tools: mode availability on this account, not the translation

routing_handshake_probe.method: SignalR handshake only, no chat invocation; six connections per ConversationId; backend read from x-calculatedbetarget
routing_handshake_probe.decision: Header sent for enterprise accounts only, and only when session_routing_pin is enabled. Default off because no lost context was observed in real multi-turn tests.

deployment.restarts: two docker restarts, both healthy, restart count 0
deployment.pre_existing_drift_left_unchanged: account_serializers.py and template_admin_accounts.py in the container are older than d16eadf; not part of this change

mandatory_matrix.detail: Sync and streaming text, no-store on streams, tool round and tool continuation pass. The continuation reply did not quote the tool result; the driver only checks for non-empty text.
Mode applied; tool round answered with x-m365-tool-calling=router.
Mode applied and the tool round succeeded, but through the Router fallback (header router). No ready Studio agent is bound, so the Studio path itself was not exercised.
Text, tool_use and tool_result continuation; streaming tool continuation also passed under item 7.
Text, function tool and continuation, plus the Codex Lite streaming tool loop above.

No enabled Consumer key, so Consumer renewal and chat were not run. Personal Substrate text returned 200. With its own default planning and gpt-5.5_Chat the personal key made no tool call, identically for additional_tools and top-level tools, so this is not caused by the change; personal tool loops do work with Router planning (item 7).

real_upgrade_401_continuations.fixture: One authentication-tag bit flipped in a private copy of the stored JWE; verified 401 at the real upgrade before each request. Run on an isolated listener with Router planning.

cleanup.not_cleaned: Conversations created by the matrix driver and the live checks through the production listener were not journaled; they remain in the accounts' Copilot history.

redaction: No API keys, tokens, cookies or account IDs. Tokens appear only as truncated SHA-256.
